title: A support engineer was handed the book during his Oxide interviews — 'Incorruptible totally changed my assumptions on how a company could be built'
summary: Knight read it on a recommendation made while he was interviewing at Oxide Computer, whose co-founder and CTO Bryan Cantrill picked the book for the Oxide and Friends annual books episode. He has since recommended it to friends of his own.
blockquote: Incorruptible totally changed my assumptions on how a company could be built. It gave me faith that the current corporate climate of shareholder primacy can be overcome long term, if we so choose.

source_urls.label: Books in the Box VI — the Oxide and Friends episode where Cantrill picked it
